caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, oval frame with a black inner border and decorative green flourishes at the top and sides. At the very top of the frame sits a brown eagle with wings slightly spread, positioned above a small, circular medallion containing a sepia-toned portrait of a man in military uniform. Below the eagle and portrait, the green scrollwork features pinkish-red flowers and foliage at each side. The lower sides of the oval frame are draped with two American flags, showing red and white stripes and portions of blue with white stars. At the bottom center of the frame is a heraldic shield, colored with red and white vertical stripes and a blue field containing white stars at the top, which is adorned at its base with clusters of green leaves and red berries or flowers. The background of the image is plain and beige, and the frame is empty in the center. The artist's signature, "J. Billings," appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Mirror Frame
